embeds.title: 🟡 Avada Builder WordPress Plugin Flaws Allow Site Credential Theft
embeds.description:
Two vulnerabilities in the Avada Builder WordPress plugin (affecting approximately one million active installations) allow attackers to read arbitrary files and extract sensitive information from databases. CVE-2026-4782 permits authenticated users with subscriber-level access to read arbitrary files including wp-config.php containing database credentials. CVE-2026-4798 is a time-based blind SQL injection exploitable without authentication if WooCommerce was previously enabled and deactivated. Security researcher Rafie Muhammad discovered both flaws through the Wordfence Bug Bounty Program. Patches were released on April 13 (partial fix, version 3.15.2) and May 12 (full fix, version 3.15.3).
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-4782, CVE-2026-4798 • **Access:** authenticated access (subscriber-level) for CVE-2026-4782; unauthenticated for CVE-2026-4798 if WooCommerce previously enabled
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
[Read source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/avada-builder-wordpress-plugin-flaws-allow-site-credential-theft/)
